newsitem.title: UK: UK Oct new car registrations jump 13.3 pct -- SMMT.
newsitem.headline: UK Oct new car registrations jump 13.3 pct -- SMMT.

text.p: New car registrations in the UK jumped 13.3 percent in October to 154,733 compared with the year-ago month, the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders (SMMT) said on Wednesday.
The car retailers group said the result was the highest total on record for October.
Total registrations for the first 10 months of the year rose 4.7 percent to 1,811,967.

"Particularly encouraging was a rise in private retail registrations of 21.02 percent (in October). This compared with a fleet and business sector rise of just 7.48 percent," the car retailers group said in a statement.
